comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Operates nursing and healthcare schools (Rasmussen) with physical campuses, tuition funded by federal aid; closest overlap, though broader with military online focus.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Mainly online, general degree universities in business, IT and culinary; healthcare is a minor part, unlike campus-based allied health.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Large online working-adult university group with Australian operations and employer programs; not focused on campus-based allied health training.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: K-12 virtual school operator funded by public school contracts; different customers and revenue model from post-secondary vocational colleges.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Campus-based for-profit vocational schools with hands-on labs, tuition from students on Title IV aid, career-focused training; different trade but similar model.
